258.title: Next nightly: bots that change files and attach files, and bot runs kept to your own Claude Code settings
258.body:
Combines these for the next nightly, so they go through CI once:

- #252 Bots that change files: Edits Files in Its Folders, approvals bound to the exact change, held kinds, Undo, the request screen, chief → specialist hand-off; with three rounds of security review fixes, and its Linux and Windows fixes (empty folders in the plain copy, exec-form hooks on Windows, an empty hooks folder and attributes file for git instead of /dev/null, the copy's top folder locked on Windows, a Claude Code version check)
- #255 Bots attach files from their folders (PDFs, documents, pictures), waiting for you unless Send Files From Its Folders Without Asking says otherwise; a content scan for keys and tokens; folders that now lead elsewhere shown in Needs You (Folders Not Read)
- #257 Bot runs load only your own Claude Code settings (--setting-sources user), never a folder's own, with reads outside their folders blocked; bots need Claude Code 2.1.257 or later and say so
- #250 Tests: the two suites that failed tonight's nightly, bots-always-on and chat-account
- #256 Watch a screen waits for the floating card before it starts
- (#253, Models for Each Task, follows in the next one.)
- Tests: bots-write on Windows says what rights its agent ran with

Every Claude Code bot run gets one settings file: the read block, the deny rules for hidden and secret files, and the guard hook for runs that change files.

## Tests

On the combined branch: bots-write 150 (WebKit 150), bots-files 132 (WebKit 132), settings-ui 137 (WebKit 137), all passing.
